properties.value: Licensed under Apache 2.0; intended for research and educational use in accordance with Ai2's Responsible Use Guidelines (https://allenai.org/responsible-use)

properties.name: model-cards:integration_means
properties.value: Use with the HuggingFace transformers library (transformers 4.57.0 or higher) via AutoModelForCausalLM/AutoTokenizer; optional 8-bit quantization with bitsandbytes; specific checkpoints loadable via the revision argument; fine-tuning with the OLMo-core repository.

properties.name: model-cards:distribution_channels
properties.value: Open weights/checkpoints released on Hugging Face (loadable with the transformers library, including intermediate revisions); code released on GitHub repositories.

performanceMetrics.value: Olmo 3.1 32B Instruct scores: MATH 93.4, AIME 2024 67.8, AIME 2025 57.9, OMEGA 42.2, BigBenchHard 84.0, ZebraLogic 61.7, AGI Eval English 79.5, HumanEvalPlus 86.7, MBPP+ 65.1, LiveCodeBench v3 54.7, IFEval 88.8, IFBench 39.7, MMLU 80.9, PopQA 25.0, GPQA 48.6, AlpacaEval 2 LC 59.8, Safety 89.5

useCases: Intended for research and educational use in accordance with Ai2's Responsible Use Guidelines.
technicalLimitations: Without safety filtering, the models can easily be prompted by users to generate harmful and sensitive content; such content may also be produced unintentionally, especially involving bias. Many statements from OLMo or any LLM are often inaccurate, so facts should be verified.

ethicalConsiderations.name: The evaluation table includes a Safety score for Olmo 3.1 32B Instruct of 89.5 (SFT 92.1, DPO 88.9), compared with other models (e.g., Apertus 70B 77.1, Qwen 3 32B (No Think) 81.6, Gemma 3 27B 68.8, OLMo 2 32B 84.2). No red-teaming is described.
